diseases.name: Generalised anxiety disorder
diseases.inv: Clinical interview; GAD-7 is a screening tool; exclude thyroid and drug causes.
diseases.alt: Panic disorder, depression, thyrotoxicosis, substance effects

diseases.name: Panic disorder
diseases.inv: Clinical; ECG and TSH to exclude cardiac and thyroid causes first.
diseases.alt: Cardiac arrhythmia, thyrotoxicosis, asthma, substance effect

diseases.name: Medical or substance-induced anxiety
diseases.inv: TSH, glucose, ECG, caffeine and drug review.

diseases.name: Specific phobia / social anxiety disorder
diseases.inv: Clinical interview.

diseases.name: Obsessive-compulsive disorder
diseases.inv: Clinical interview; Y-BOCS for severity by specialist.

diseases.name: Post-traumatic stress disorder
diseases.inv: Clinical interview; screen for depression and substance use.
diseases.alt: Acute stress reaction, depression, adjustment disorder

diseases.name: Insomnia disorder
diseases.inv: Sleep history, screen for depression, anxiety, sleep apnoea, drugs.
diseases.alt: Depression, mania, sleep apnoea, restless legs

diseases.name: Manic / bipolar episode
diseases.inv: Urgent psychiatric assessment; rule out substances and thyroid disease; assess risk.

diseases.name: Schizophrenia spectrum illness
diseases.inv: Psychiatric assessment; exclude substances, delirium and medical causes.
diseases.alt: Substance-induced psychosis, mania, depression with psychosis, delirium

diseases.name: Substance-induced psychosis
diseases.inv: Toxicology, observation, psychiatric review.

diseases.name: Delirium (acute confusional state)
diseases.inv: Look for infection, drugs, electrolytes, hypoxia, glucose, retention, withdrawal; treat the cause.
diseases.tool: CAM is a bedside delirium screening method; apply per intended use.

diseases.name: Dementia (e.g. Alzheimer disease)
diseases.inv: Cognitive screen (e.g. MMSE/MoCA), B12, TSH, neuroimaging as indicated.
diseases.tool: MMSE/MoCA are screening tools, not diagnoses.

diseases.name: Vascular cognitive impairment
diseases.inv: Vascular risk factor control, imaging, cognitive screen.
diseases.alt: Alzheimer disease, depression, normal pressure hydrocephalus

diseases.name: Reversible cause of memory trouble (B12, thyroid, depression, drugs)
diseases.inv: B12, TSH, glucose, electrolytes; review drugs; screen for depression.

diseases.name: Alcohol withdrawal / delirium tremens
diseases.inv: Urgent medical assessment; glucose, electrolytes, thiamine; monitor vitals.
diseases.alt: Delirium from other cause, infection, hypoglycaemia

diseases.name: Alcohol use disorder / dependence
diseases.inv: AUDIT screening; LFTs, CBC; assess withdrawal risk.

diseases.name: Wernicke encephalopathy
diseases.inv: Urgent thiamine before glucose; medical assessment.

diseases.name: Opioid toxicity / overdose
diseases.inv: Emergency airway support; naloxone as per protocol.
diseases.alt: Other sedative overdose, head injury, hypoglycaemia

diseases.name: Substance use disorder
diseases.inv: Substance history, urine toxicology, screen for infections (HIV, hepatitis).

diseases.name: High suicide risk (urgent risk assessment)
diseases.inv: Immediate safety assessment by trained clinician; do not leave the patient alone; involve family.
diseases.tool: No risk score predicts suicide reliably; use structured clinical assessment.

diseases.name: Somatic symptom disorder
diseases.inv: Diagnosis after thorough medical assessment; avoid repeated unnecessary tests.

diseases.name: ADHD
diseases.inv: Clinical assessment with parent and teacher reports.

diseases.name: Autism spectrum disorder
diseases.inv: Developmental assessment; hearing test.
diseases.alt: Language delay, hearing loss, intellectual disability

diseases.name: Conduct disorder
diseases.inv: Clinical assessment of home, school and peers.

flags.text: Suicide plan, means or intent: immediate safety assessment, do not leave the patient alone
Possible alcohol withdrawal (tremor, hallucinations or seizures): medical emergency
Confusion or unsteady gait with heavy alcohol use: possible Wernicke encephalopathy, urgent thiamine
Pinpoint pupils, slow breathing, drowsiness: possible opioid overdose, emergency
Acute fluctuating confusion: possible delirium, search for the medical cause urgently
Elevated mood with reduced sleep and risky behaviour: possible mania, assess risk and safety
